Dr. Eleanor Voss  
Department of Computer Science  
University of New Terra  
elvoss@university.edu  
October 5, 2023  

To Whom It May Concern,  

It is with great enthusiasm that I recommend Alexandra ‘Lexi’ Mitchell for any opportunity requiring a blend of technical acumen, strategic thinking, and collaborative leadership. As a professor who has occasionally collaborated with Lexi on cloud computing research initiatives, I have observed her evolve from a promising student into a formidable Platform Engineer at CloudForge Solutions.  

Lexi’s mastery of AWS infrastructure is exemplified by her 2022 project, where she redesigned CloudForge’s cost structure, reducing annual cloud expenditures by 30% through optimized resource allocation and spot instance strategies. Her ownership of Kubernetes clusters at scale is equally impressive; she spearheaded a migration of a legacy monolith to microservices, achieving a 40% improvement in deployment latency while maintaining zero downtime during peak traffic periods.  

Her work with Terraform to automate infrastructure-as-code processes eliminated manual configuration errors, streamlining onboarding for new engineers by 50%. Lexi’s CI/CD pipelines, built using GitLab CI, ensure rapid, reliable deployments, a practice now standard across CloudForge’s consulting teams.  

Beyond technical prowess, Lexi’s work ethic is exceptional. She consistently volunteers to mentor junior engineers, and her ability to balance complex system optimizations with clear communication has made her an indispensable collaborator. Her recent implementation of Prometheus/Grafana dashboards for real-time monitoring has already saved her team 20+ hours monthly in troubleshooting.  

Lexi’s blend of innovation, precision, and leadership makes her a standout professional. I wholeheartedly endorse her for any role requiring technical excellence and strategic impact.  

Sincerely,  
Dr. Eleanor Voss
